Join us and be part of creating
Monopoly World – an innovative mobile game that brings the classic board game to life in the real world. As a Unity Animator, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the visual experience of a project with global reach, where players explore and acquire real-world properties through engaging, dynamic animations.

Check out our trailer for the Monopoly World project:

Join us full-time at our stunning office located in the heart of Krakow! Situated in a historic building just steps away from the vibrant city center, our workspace blends timeless charm with modern amenities, providing an inspiring setting for your personal and professional growth.

If you’re moving to Krakow to join us, we’ve got you covered with a relocation package designed to make the process seamless and stress-free.

Responsibilities

• Develop and implement engaging UI animations, including transitions, panel animations, and interactive visual effects.
• Create gameplay animations that bring life to in-game interactions and environments.
• Work closely with designers and developers to ensure animations are aligned with the game's vision.
• Optimize animations for performance across a variety of mobile devices.
• Prototype and implement visual effects to improve the overall user experience.
• Collaborate with the team to ensure seamless integration of animations into the game.
